verdict.rationale: First-party product docs explicitly state that permissions can be controlled at the workspace, project, and repo level, plus granular branch-level permissions. That matches every level the story names. One older community report says admins could not stop members from making repositories public, which points to a specific admin-control gap but does not contradict the layered permission model. Missing for 10: in-depth permission docs beyond a single marketing line, independent or hands-on corroboration of branch-level controls, and evidence that admins can restrict repository visibility.
